questions.stem: Why do large food molecules need to be digested before they can be absorbed?

options.text: Large molecules cannot dissolve in stomach acid
Large molecules are toxic to the body
Large molecules are too big to pass through the walls of the small intestine into the blood
Large molecules have no nutritional value

questions.explanation: Large, insoluble molecules like starch and proteins cannot pass through the intestinal wall. They must be broken down into smaller, soluble molecules that can be absorbed into the blood.
